tail:
**B10-1 applied; B10-2/3/4 verified already repaired on disk; B10-5/6/7 outside a Beta's write boundary; B10-8 no action.** Batch 10 files only; nothing else touched.

**B10-1 — required-form treatment harvested.** Added to `research/frontier-18-batch-10.coverage.json` on `modules-substitution-and-prime-graphs`: T. Harju, *Lecture Notes on Combinatorial Structures in Graph Theory* (Turku, 2019), `kind: lecture-notes`, `https://users.utu.fi/harju/Structures/Structure2018.pdf`, §§1–5 in full (notes pp. 1–31 = PDF pp. 4–34), fetch-stamped (pdf, 501 289 bytes, 61 pages). It is a full lecture-note set with its own TOC, independent of Habib–Paul, by a co-author of *The Theory of 2-Structures* — the monograph Alpha named — and §§1–5 are the pair's exact subject.

Alpha's other candidates were checked first: Golumbic, Ehrenfeucht–Harju–Rozenberg and Brandstädt–Le–Spinrad have no open full text (publisher, bookseller and Internet Archive *lending* pages only, none of which stamps). Bang-Jensen–Gutin's *Digraphs*, whose full PDF is free, was downloaded and searched and rejected on content: of 15 pages matching `modul`, twelve concern sub/supermodular set functions in the flow chapter, two are bibliography lines and one an index line — it has no treatment of modules of a graph.

**Harvest:** 86 headings — every section/subsection, every numbered result, the substantive exercises, remarks and examples, and the per-section reference notes. 29 `included`, 10 `inline`, 1 `already-published`, 29 `deferred`, 17 `out-of-scope`; every deferral resolves (`cographs-perfect-patterns-and-pure-pairs` for the cograph/uniform-non-primitivity block, `small-graph-erdos-hajnal-consequences` for the extension and deletion theorems — the destination this file already uses for Habib–Paul's Lemma 6, the same theorem — and `owner-decision` for the strong-module and critically-primitive theory, matching the F7 declines you confirmed).

**Three items added** (each a harvested heading the decline rule forbids declining; short proofs, dependencies already on the page):
- `lem-the-quotient-is-an-induced-subgraph-on-a-transversal` (Harju Thm 3.1) — exhibits the quotient as an induced subgraph.
- `cor-the-modular-partition-with-a-prime-quotient-is-unique` (Thms 3.10, 4.5) — canonicity of the modular decomposition, proved from three lemmas already on the page.
- `cex-maximal-proper-modules-need-not-be-disjoint-in-a-disconnected-graph` (Remark 4.1, which asserts the fact without a witness).

The convention check found real mathematics: Harju's uniqueness needs *truly* primitive (≥ 3 vertices), and under this page's `def-prime-graph` a two-vertex graph is prime, so the edgeless graph on three vertices has **two** modular partitions with prime quotients. The corollary therefore carries the connected-and-anticonnected hypothesis, and the counterexample is what shows both hypotheses are load-bearing. Provenance, truth-risk check and the source URL for each are in the notes; three contracts added, `scope` 73 → 76. **No existing item's deps, title or strategy changed** — the splice is additive. Pages are now 36 (A) and 14 (B) against the 60 cap; no split.

**Gates re-run:** `source-fetch-check` 9/9 verified (1 new stamp); `url-sweep --recover --fail-on-dead` 8/8 live; `coverage-checklist --require-destination` 245 harvested, 0 errors, 2 `coverage-low-yield` warnings (page yield improved from 17/67 to 46/153); `content-policy --manifest-only` over all batch manifests 796 items, 0 errors, 0 warnings; `validate-plan` exit 0 (`redundant-prereq` advisories only — my ids splice at step 4); `prosecheck --warnings` 0 errors. `proof-contract` reports 76 `item-missing`, 0/76 checked — the documented pre-authoring state (it reads `items/` from disk; it was 73/73 before). I checked dependency resolution and page order for the whole batch by hand instead of `depsource`, which needs the splice: 0 unresolved and 0 forward references.

**Not verified:** that the harvest is *faithful* to Harju beyond §§1–5, which I read in full for this pass — §§6–8 (switching) were not read and are not claimed; and the three new proofs are checked by me only.
